    sequentially with local compute operations in between. No fusion or overlapping.
    
    The computation follows the reference implementation exactly:
    1. Initial all-reduce to compute sum s
    2. Six iterations of normalization rounds, each consisting of:
       - Divide by normalization factor g

    W = world_size
